description: Chrome of the TmDashboard widget card (TG-009): the header with the category icon tile, title, description, collapse chevron and host WidgetHeaderActions, plus the edit-mode drag handle / move buttons and remove control. Switching modes never changes the grid placement (columns/rows) or the widget order — but entering edit mode adds the header bar above the card content, so the content shifts down by roughly the header height while the widget keeps its exact grid cells.
